subjects.description: A solid structural wall that terminates the old-town boulevard, its flat vertical face entirely covered by a hyper-realistic trompe-l'oeil mural depicting an open road stretching toward a distant horizon beneath a clear blue sky
subjects.appearance_details: The painted mural shows asphalt lane markings receding to a vanishing point, soft cumulus clouds, and a graduated blue sky; a warm golden-hour cast and subtle brush sheen across the paint, and the faint seam where the mural meets adjacent structures, reveal it is a flat painted surface
subjects.relationship: It is the terminal obstacle the ego vehicle must recognize and stop before; it deceptively mimics a continuation of the street
subjects.location: center frame, filling the far end of the street
subjects.orientation: facing directly toward the camera/ego vehicle
subjects.action: Standing as a fixed barrier closing off the road
subjects.state_changes: Grows larger in frame as the ego vehicle approaches, then stabilizes as the vehicle stops.

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, an autonomous passenger car, seen only through its forward-facing point of view as it travels down the golden-lit old-town boulevard
subjects.appearance_details: Implied by the dashboard-level ego perspective; smooth motion suggests a modern sedan with advanced driver-assistance sensors
subjects.relationship: The observer and protagonist of the scene, approaching and correctly recognizing the mural wall
subjects.orientation: facing forward down the street toward the wall
subjects.pose: moving forward then decelerating to a halt
subjects.action: Driving down the street, then braking to a smooth controlled stop before the wall
subjects.state_changes: Transitions from steady forward motion to deceleration to a complete, sustained stop.

background_setting: A tree-lined boulevard in a European old town at golden-hour morning, flanked by ornate stone and stucco townhouses with shuttered windows, parked cars along cobblestone-edged curbs and blossoming spring trees. The central asphalt lane is bordered by cobblestones, with faded lane markings running straight ahead. The street dead-ends at a solid structural wall whose surface bears a hyper-realistic mural of an open road and clear sky, creating an optical illusion of the boulevard continuing. No traffic signs of any kind are present anywhere in the scene.

lighting.direction: Low sun from the east, raking across the scene from the right
lighting.shadows: Long, soft warm shadows of trees and townhouses stretching across the road, all aligned
lighting.illumination_effect: Golden low light warms the stone facades and lends the painted mural a warm morning cast, though its fixed blue sky is now dusk-tinted at the edges while the illusion still reads convincingly

aesthetics.composition: Centered one-point perspective with the boulevard receding toward the mural wall at the vanishing point; blossoming trees and townhouses frame the road symmetrically
aesthetics.color_scheme: Warm golden stone and stucco, spring pink and green blossoms, mellow asphalt and the painted mural's blue softened by golden light
aesthetics.patterns: Rhythmic townhouse windows, regularly spaced trees and cobblestone texture at the road edges

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.focus: The mural wall and the full length of the street ahead

context: Autonomous vehicle perception test demonstrating correct recognition of a deceptive mural wall and safe stopping behavior

actions.description: The ego vehicle travels steadily forward down the golden-lit old-town boulevard toward the mural wall at the far end.
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

The vehicle comes to a complete stop before the wall and remains stationary, holding the view of the mural in warm morning light; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

segments.description: Ego vehicle drives forward down the straight, blossom-lined boulevard, the mural wall growing larger ahead while townhouses and parked cars pass on either side under long shadows.
segments.key_changes: Steady approach; wall increases in apparent size, warmed by golden light.
segments.camera: Forward tracking motion at constant speed, eye-level.

segments.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.
segments.key_changes: Speed falls steadily from moderate to exactly zero across two full seconds; the forward motion of the scene slows visibly frame by frame until it ceases entirely at 0:03.5
segments.camera: Forward dashcam motion decelerating smoothly and continuously, coming to a complete rest at 0:03.5

segments.description: The vehicle is fully stopped before the wall and remains stationary, holding a steady view of the golden-lit trompe-l'oeil mural. The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:03.5 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.
segments.key_changes: Zero motion of any kind; the frame is static and locked off; everything holds exactly the same position in frame
segments.camera: Locked-off stationary camera, zero translation, zero vibration, as if mounted on a tripod in a parked car

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the ego vehicle travels steadily forward down the golden-lit old-town boulevard toward the mural wall at the far end. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient old-town morning sounds: the low hum of the vehicle's electric motor and tires on asphalt with a faint cobblestone rumble at the edges, birdsong, distant footsteps and a light spring breeze. As the vehicle slows, a soft regenerative braking whir is audible, followed by the quiet of the stationary vehicle. No speech or music.
